import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int K;
    static long N;
    static Matrix[][] A = new Matrix[65][30];
    static Matrix[][] P = new Matrix[65][30];
    static Matrix[][] S = new Matrix[65][30];
    static Matrix R = new Matrix();

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] m = new int[31][31];

        Matrix() {
            for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 31; j++) {
                    m[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix();
            for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= K; k++) {
                        sum += (long) this.m[i][k] * other.m[k][j];
                    }
                    res.m[i][j] = (int) (sum % MOD);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextInt();

        // Extract digits of N in base K
        int[] digits = new int[64];
        int len = 0;
        long tempN = N;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            digits[len++] = (int) (tempN % K);
            tempN /= K;
        }

        // Initialize matrices A[0][i]
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                A[0][i] = new Matrix();
                A[0][i].m[j][j] = 1;
                A[0][i].m[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        // Build matrices for each digit
        for (int i = 1; i < len; i++) {
            // P[i-1][j]
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                P[i - 1][j] = new Matrix();
            }
            P[i - 1][0] = A[i - 1][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                P[i - 1][j] = P[i - 1][j - 1].multiply(A[i - 1][j]);
            }

            // S[i-1][j]
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                S[i - 1][j] = new Matrix();
            }
            S[i - 1][K - 1] = A[i - 1][K - 1];
            for (int j = K - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                S[i - 1][j] = A[i - 1][j].multiply(S[i - 1][j + 1]);
            }

            // A[i][j]
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                A[i][j] = S[i - 1][j];
                if (j > 0) {
                    A[i][j] = A[i][j].multiply(P[i - 1][j - 1]);
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize R as identity matrix
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            R.m[i][i] = 1;
        }

        int index = 0;
        for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < digits[i]; j++) {
                R = R.multiply(A[i][index]);
                index = (index + 1) % K;
            }
        }

        int total_sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            total_sum = (total_sum + R.m[i][K]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(total_sum);
        sc.close();
    }
}
